Message:
Ever since that day,
I wandered the forest alone.

All to find the “answer”
Mother urged me to seek...

But, it wasn’t like I’d find it
lying around somewhere
on the forest floor...

She told me to
“find the answer myself”...
but where do I even begin...?

Just as I heaved
a sigh to myself,
I saw a group of squirrels
running away from something.

“Cu Sith, get those
humans for us, alright?!”

One of the squirrels came up
to me and begged for help...
But...what are “humans”...?

...No... Forget it.
Just hurry up an’
get out of here too, okay?!”

Leaving me with only that,
the squirrel darted back
into its nest.

I don’t really get it, but...
Does that mean if I drive out
those animals called...humans,

I’ll no longer be
the forest’s failure...?

After all, up until now,
Mother was the one who
drove out any animals
threatening the forest.

So, if I can drive
those humans out,
maybe Mother will
let me stay here...!
